description: Aggregate, keyless facts about the dataset itself: total live listings, employers with a live listing, per-source breakdown, and freshness (how recently every row was last re-confirmed live at its source). Optionally also the full per-country coverage breakdown and the top-500-employer coverage audit table (each with the board URL probed, the HTTP status returned, and when it was checked). No API key needed or accepted -- the whole point of this tool is that a buyer can check these claims before creating an account.

include_countries.description: Also include the full per-country coverage breakdown.

include_employers.description: Also include the top-500-employer coverage audit table.

name: coverage
title: Dataset coverage, size and freshness (keyless)
